profile.name: Lonnie Allen Watson
profile.title: Technological fossil
profile.lede: Software architect, at the keyboard since grade school in the late '70s. These days I rebuild the arcade and RPG classics I grew up on in C# and Avalonia, so they run natively on Windows, macOS and Linux, Intel or ARM.
about: I'm now an old architect in a small piece of a very large company that bought us about twelve years ago. I've been into computers since grade school in the late '70s, and I still like building things end to end.

At work I'm focused on modernization. At home it's local LLMs, single-board computers, and recreating the games that got me hooked, built from their documented behavior and released for every platform I can reach.

games.blurb: Defender rebuilt from the original's documented behaviour: smart bombs, hyperspace, humanoid rescues and the hall of fame.
Twin-stick arena shooter. Save the last human family from wave after wave of grunts, brains and enforcers.
Ride the rim of the tube in red vector wireframe, with gamepad support and the warp between levels.
Wireframe terrain, a fuel gauge and a landing pad. Watch your vertical speed, and the asteroids.
Inertia, wraparound space, saucers with an alert siren, and controller support.
Bounce off the octagon's walls while droids lay mines. Spawn protection and explosions included.
Defend the rear of your ship in 3D vector space. Now with Capitol Ship mini-bosses, turrets and missiles.
Shoot through three counter-rotating rings to hit the cannon, while it fires through the gaps and homing mines close in.
Command the Enterprise from a 3D main viewer and tactical scanner against Klingons, anti-matter saucers and Nomad, docking at starbases to refill.
Dogfight TIE fighters, skim the Death Star's towers, then run the trench past Vader and put a torpedo down the exhaust port.
Tank combat through the periscope on a wireframe plain: radar, tanks, missiles, supertanks and the saucer, under the volcano.
Mine planetoids for Sinibombs while workers build the Sinistar piece by piece. Beware, I live!
Shoot your way through a maze of electrified rooms and talking robots before Evil Otto bounces in. Intruder alert!
Defend six cities from warheads, MIRVs, bombers and smart bombs with three missile bases, until THE END.
Fight the star's pull, raze bunkered planets, tractor fuel aboard and escape the reactor before it blows.
The march of the invaders, synthesised sound effects and full gamepad support.
Swooping waves, a breathing formation, and a tractor beam: lose a fighter, win it back, and fly two at once.
Flap your ostrich above the buzzard riders: the higher lance wins. Grab the eggs before they hatch; two can play at once.
Shoot the centipede apart in a field of mushrooms while the spider, flea and scorpion close in. Steer with the mouse like a trackball.
Drive the moon buggy from A to Z: jump craters and mines, shoot rocks and tanks ahead and saucers overhead, and beat the clock to each checkpoint.
Clear an original maze while four ghosts hunt you, each its own way; eat an energizer and turn the chase round. Fruit, coffee breaks and a rising siren.
Climb the building site to rescue the captive: jump the ape's barrels, grab a hammer, ride the lifts and pull every rivet to bring him down.
Hop five frogs home across the traffic and the river: ride logs and diving turtles, dodge the snake and the crocodiles, and beat the clock.
Tunnel through four layers of earth, pump the monsters up until they pop, dodge the fire, and drop rocks on whatever's below.
Walk the burger layers down the floors onto the plates while a sausage, an egg and a pickle chase you; pepper them, squash them, or take them for a ride.
Hop diagonally round a pyramid of cubes changing every colour; dodge the bouncing balls, lure the viper off the edge from a spinning disc, and curse when caught.
Draw lines across the open field and close them on the border to claim ground, while the qix tumbles about and the sparx run the border after you.
Gather every piece of gold and climb out the top; dig holes to trap the guards. Eight original levels and a level editor for making your own.
Six adventurers, a ten-level wireframe maze, and the mad archmage Morthrain waiting at the bottom.
The 50-level dungeon rebuilt room for room, in real time, with a Modern mode that adds an automap and no time limit.
Party creation, towns, dungeons, gem socketing and an OpenAL soundtrack.
Skara Brae and its catacombs, procedural music that darkens as you descend, and a second tower to delve.
First-person party dungeon crawl with towns, automap, riddles, daily challenges and a map editor.
Angband 4.2 in C#. Its game data is checked against 4.2.5 on every build.

games.name: AVAFlight
games.blurb: Crew, starships, alien diplomacy, planet surveys by terrain vehicle, and real-time combat.
Trading, docking and dogfights across eight galaxies, rendered in wireframe.

tools.blurb: Visio-style diagram editor. Reads .vsdx; exports SVG, PNG, PDF, Mermaid and .vsdx.
highlights: 167 stencils: flowchart, BPMN, UML, network, electrical, logic and more
Connectors that route themselves round shapes, and round each other
Opens Visio, SVG and Mermaid; exports SVG, PNG, PDF and .vsdx

tools.name: DORI
tools.blurb: Directory Opus reimagined: a cross-platform file explorer in .NET and Avalonia.
highlights: Two panels with folder tabs, after the Amiga's Directory Opus
Compares and syncs folders, by date or by content hash
Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3 and 40 more, through rclone

tools.blurb: Graphical query builder for Microsoft SQL Server.
highlights: Builds SELECT queries as a diagram of tables, joins and filters
25+ derived fields, GROUP BY with HAVING, sorting, TOP and DISTINCT
Finds SQL Servers on the network, runs the query and shows the rows

tools.name: CirqAvalonia
tools.blurb: Electronic circuit simulator: draw a schematic and watch it run on a live oscilloscope.
highlights: 186 parts: RLC, transistors, op-amps, the 555, 74xx and 4000 logic, displays
SPICE-style analog solver and event-driven digital logic in one simulation
Live triggered scope, frequency response, FFT and protocol decoding

tools.blurb: CODE Complete rebuilt: point it at a database table and it writes the C# data class.
highlights: Browses SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite and Oracle
Writes a typed C# class: async read, add, update, delete and list getters
Browse one engine and generate for another, to port a table between them

tools.blurb: Shows the raw bytes a USB or Bluetooth game controller sends, live, for writing code that reads it.
highlights: Lists every connected USB and Bluetooth controller by VID:PID
Each byte live in hex and binary, lit up the moment it changes
Xbox-style pads read through XInput on Windows, HID everywhere else

tools.name: Vector Match Engine
tools.blurb: Finds the same person or company across two Excel sheets with no shared key and the names spelled differently.
highlights: Each row becomes a 512-dimension vector of character trigrams, so typos stay close
Every record in A scored against every one in B, above a threshold you set
Matched pairs side by side, exported to a formatted Excel workbook

tools.blurb: A lightweight Jira-style issue tracker, in the making, to run as SaaS or on your own server.
highlights: A drag-and-drop kanban board that updates live in every open browser
A database per tenant for SaaS, or one Docker stack on-prem
Full-text search, invites, single sign-on (OIDC) and an audit log

tools.blurb: Structured drawing canvas that code can populate and users can interact with.
highlights: Graph-paper canvas of entities joined by arrowed connectors
Snap to grid, automatic placement, and dragging with live connectors
Click, double-click, right-click and hover events carry your metadata

tools.blurb: The VB.Net-era LineChart control, rebuilt for Windows, macOS and Linux.
highlights: Up to ten data series, with polynomial trend lines
Animated flashing to pick one series out of the rest
Grid, knot markers and banded backgrounds; every colour and font styleable
Loads .3DS, .OBJ, .STL, .PLY and .FBX models
Wireframe drawing, centred and scaled to fit automatically
Smooth rotation on all three axes, at any speed
Up to ten timeline rows side by side
30 chicklet styles: ten colours, each a box, a circle or a triangle
Wheel and keyboard scrolling, weekends, month labels and overlap markers

tools.blurb: Syntax-highlighting text box for Avalonia, with no dependencies beyond Avalonia itself.
highlights: Highlights 38 languages as you type, from C# and Rust to T-SQL and Mermaid
14 built-in colour themes, and line numbers you can switch off
Linting with your own rules, and an MVVM-friendly design
